Author: Glamour Pact contributors
Name: Glamour Pact
Punchline: Dom-controlled looks, local Synced Mods and opt-in strict controls.
Description: An opt-in Dom/Sub outfit library with named outfits, copyable macros, configurable glam locks, local Synced Looks and Customize+ profile/template choices. Shared Customize+ profiles require separate consent. Automatic styling pauses safely during transfers; helmet controls never edit weapons. Optional exact-Dom follow, looping pose locks and GPact Offline control; disabling the plugin remains the local exit. Update both players to 0.6.4 for reduced idle status traffic while preserving responsive controls.
Changelog: Reduces hidden idle Dom state reads: enabling automatic styling alone no longer forces continuous fast polling. Idle unlocked telemetry uses a 10-second interval; manually locked peers retain the four-second per-peer budget. Opening controls or an accepted outfit edit requests an immediate refresh; unchanged raw callbacks do not. Fast observation of stalled drafts ends after 15 minutes without deleting them; a later accepted install renews observation. Active command delivery, four-second Offline-lock renewals and the 30-second fail-safe lease are unchanged. Production checks confirm existing D1 cleanup indexes are already present and used. Client-only update: no new index, Worker deployment, SeitonSense or native-reference changes. Update both players.
